1:57 PM. You said:

My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?

01:57 PM

I’m really sorry about that. If tracking shows delivered but you didn’t receive the package, it can happen that carriers mark deliveries a bit early, or the delivery may have been left somewhere discreet.

Please check with neighbors, roommates, friends, family, or a doorman (in case someone accepted it for you), and double-check the shipping address is correct. Also, if you’ve contacted the carrier for more delivery details, that can help.

If it’s been more than 3 business days since it was marked delivered, I’m going to loop in one of our human agents so they can take a closer look and help get this sorted out for you. If you’d like, you can leave your email address here so the team can contact you as they review the details.
